answer: A V12 model contract must attach a measurement record to any input labeled measured: a named source, a measurement method, the sample size, and the period. The parameter block carries the evidence status, source identifiers and note, and the validator checks that every measured parameter has a source and a measurement record. Status may change only with new evidence; an assumed value copied into a measured field does not become measured, and a derived value inherits the weakest status of its inputs.
